verdict.rationale: The pack documents `tofu import`, which adds existing resources to state, and refresh-only plans, which sync state with remote objects. Neither is a way to inspect, move, remove, or rename resources in state during refactoring. There is no evidence of state list, show, mv, or rm commands or of moved/removed blocks, so these are only adjacent features.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can safely inspect and modify state — moving, removing, or renaming resources — when refactoring
